SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   C. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

4. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.
   B. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.
   D. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.
   D. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   C. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.

8. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.
   C. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

11. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   B. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
   C. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Esteem Assessment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
